z-m-28-03.goal: Hlola ukuthi izixazululo ezihlukile zilungile yini ngenani lokuhlelwa uma izinto ezibukeka zifana zixutshiwe, bese usebenza isizathu sezinyathelo ezidla noma ezihlukanisa.
z-m-28-03.material:
Kunamakhadi angu-6 ezinhlamvu. Angu-3 ngu-A, angu-2 ngu-N, futhi o-1 ngu-B, futhi amakhadi anohlamvu olufanayo abukeka efana ncamashi, ngakho awakwazi ukuhlukaniswa. Abantu abathathu bakhulule ngokuhlukile inani lokuhlelwa kwezinhlamvu okuhlukile (isibonelo: BANANA, ABNANA) okungenziwa ngokubeka amakhadi angu-6 emgqeni.
U-Seoha: Kunezinhlobo ezingu-3 zezinhlamvu, ngakho indlela yokulayina izinto ezingu-3 ngu-3×2×1=6 izindlela.
U-Harin: Uma sithatha zonke ezingu-6 njengezihlukile, kungu-720 izindlela. Ukushintshanisa izinhlamvu ezifanayo kunikeza ukuhlelwa okufanayo, ngakho hlukanisa ngama-oda angu-6 wamakhadi angu-3 e-A nama-oda angu-2 amakhadi angu-2 e-N: 720÷12=60 izindlela.
U-Junho: Kunezindlela ezingu-20 zokukhetha izindawo ezingu-3 kwezingu-6 ze-A. Phakathi kwezindawo ezingu-3 ezisele, kunezindlela ezingu-3 zokukhetha izindawo ezingu-2 ze-N. U-B uya endaweni esele, ngakho 20×3=60 izindlela.
